biomarker_unit.notes: LDA score >4.0 was used as a threshold for biomarker identification, but exact per-biomarker LDA values are only shown in Figure 3C, not stated numerically in text.

biomarker_value.notes: Quantitative LDA/abundance values for each biomarker are only presented graphically (Figure 3C), not as text values.
